Tandem queue with blocking — one buffer space between two stations

Two stages separated by a buffer with room for exactly one part — the classic blocking model.

What to watch for

A part must take the buffer before releasing stage 1, and take stage 2 before releasing the buffer. So when the buffer is full, stage 1 finishes its work and then simply stands there holding the part: blocked, not busy. Watch how much of stage 1's time goes that way.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (77 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
